extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed CrowdStrike Falcon sensor version, or "Not Installed".
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # The Falcon sensor exposes its build via the cs.version sysctl OID on # every supported macOS version since 10.13.
ver=$(/usr/sbin/sysctl -n cs.version 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$ver" ]]; then echo "<result>Version $ver</result>" else echo "<result>Not Installed or Running</result>" fi
